heading: 4D v16 - Upgrade
reason: Upgrade is a distinct source family. The overview describes features added since v15 R5; new-feature headings are not automatically migration requirements or exact introduction thresholds. Structural extraction and linked-section inspection do not mean complete cataloging. Linked conversion/deprecation sources remain distinct; failed conversion/opening stays outside scope.

heading: Non-compliance with object notation
reason: Failure to convert or open is outside this reference: contact official 4D Support. Post-opening object-notation and compiler requirements need separate evidence-backed records; they have not yet been cataloged.

heading: Interprocess variables
reason: The cumulative v20 edition labels these deprecated, not removed. Exact introduction threshold and cross-edition alignment still need review; do not infer a v20 removal.
